name: hf_endpoints
summary: Management plane for Hugging Face Inference Endpoints — dedicated, always-on deployments of a specific model on specific hardware. DISTINCT from hf_hub.py (which is the 19-provider per-call router). Surface: list_endpoints / get_endpoint / deploy_endpoint / pause_endpoint / resume_endpoint / delete_endpoint / predict, plus a deploy_canonical convenience that ships a tiny default text model on the cheapest tier. Every deploy* function REQUIRES confirm=True. Every operation crystal-anchors via inference_logger.log() with tier='deploy' (control-plane) or tier='inference' (data-plane). stdlib-only — reuses hf_hub._load_token / _http_get / _http_post.
engine_pattern: stdlib-only urllib HTTPS client against api.endpoints.huggingface.cloud/v2/endpoint/<namespace>. Token resolved via hf_hub._load_token (env HF_TOKEN → HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN → ~/.cache/huggingface/token → .env). Every operation appends to studio/hf_endpoints/log.jsonl AND emits a crystal-anchored entry on the master inference chain. _http_delete added locally since hf_hub.py only exposes GET/POST.

cost_warning.billing_model: HOURLY — billed per minute while endpoint is running, even if idle
cost_warning.implication: Accidentally deploying a single GPU endpoint can incur $1–$15/hour. A cpu-basic endpoint forgotten over a weekend is still ~$3+. There is no per-call free tier.
safety_rails: deploy_endpoint() REQUIRES confirm=True parameter — refuses with {success:False, error:'deploy requires confirm=True; hourly billing'} otherwise
deploy_canonical() REQUIRES confirm=True — same refusal contract
Refusal events are crystal-anchored too — tier='deploy' model='hf_endpoint' rc=2 — so the chain has a tamper-evident record of every gated call
cost_warning.operator_checklist: Before deploying: (1) confirm namespace is the correct HF account, (2) verify hardware tier and region match expectation, (3) note the cost/hour from HF's pricing page, (4) set a calendar reminder to pause or delete the endpoint when done. After deploying: pause_endpoint() the moment work pauses; delete_endpoint() when fully done.

vs_hf_hub.hf_hub_py: Multi-provider router. Per-call billing across 19 cloud providers via OpenAI-compatible router. Free-tier-friendly. No deploy step.
vs_hf_hub.hf_endpoints_py: Dedicated endpoint manager. Hourly billing on a specific deployment of a specific model. Deploy step required. Requires confirm=True gate.
vs_hf_hub.when_to_use_which: hf_hub for ad-hoc / bursty / experimental calls (default). hf_endpoints when a workflow card needs guaranteed availability + predictable latency on a model that isn't well-served by the providers list, AND the operator has explicitly budgeted for hourly billing.

api_surface.deploy_endpoint: POST   <base>          (body: model + compute + provider)  ** confirm=True required **

substrate: studio/hf_endpoints/log.jsonl (per-call op log: ts, op, namespace, name, status, success, preview)

crystal_anchoring.control_plane_ops: deploy / pause / resume / delete — logged with tier='deploy', model='hf_endpoint', scope='<namespace>/<name>'
crystal_anchoring.data_plane_ops: predict — logged with tier='inference', model='hf_endpoint:<name>', scope=<endpoint_url>
crystal_anchoring.refusals_logged: deploy_endpoint(confirm=False) emits a chain entry with rc=2 — refusals are part of the audit trail
crystal_anchoring.rationale: Provisioning a paid endpoint is a substrate-altering action equivalent in importance to a model call. Both belong on the crystal chain.

inbound_callers: studio_runtime — when a workflow card requires a dedicated endpoint (vs. shared provider router)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: HF_TOKEN via hf_hub._load_token; HF_NAMESPACE from env (falls back to 'me')

guarantees: confirm=True gate on every deploy path — no accidental provisioning
Crystal-anchored — every op (including refusals) lands on the inference chain
Reuses hf_hub helpers — single source of truth for token + HTTP
stdlib-only — no new pip deps; only urllib + dataclasses + pathlib
Scale-to-zero by default — min_replica=0 avoids billing while idle (warm-up trade-off accepted)
usage_example:
# Read-only — safe to run anytime
cc hf-endpoints-list
cc hf-endpoints-get <namespace> <name>

# Paid op — requires --confirm
cc hf-endpoints-deploy <namespace> mspc-llama32-1b meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct --confirm

# Call a deployed endpoint
cc hf-endpoints-predict https://<endpoint>.endpoints.huggingface.cloud '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'

# Always pause when done
cc hf-endpoints-pause <namespace> mspc-llama32-1b

# Or delete entirely
cc hf-endpoints-delete <namespace> mspc-llama32-1b
